info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Hotel Rooms Amenities-v3-spec
info.description: The Hotel Room Amenities API provides access to the various amenities offered in hotel rooms, allowing users to efficiently query and retrieve a comprehensive list of available features. This endpoint primarily serves hotel management systems and travel applications, enabling them to enhance guest experience by showcasing room offerings. Developers can utilize this API to create informative displays of amenities, assisting in better customer decision-making. Integration with booking platforms and informational websites is also common for enabling easier guest access to room specifications.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch a list of amenities available for different rooms. It provides detailed information about the features and services that can enhance guest experiences during their stay.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the amenities available in rooms. It should include any relevant filters or parameters required to specify the request.
